title: Capture consent independently without external dependencies
gherkin:
Feature: Independent Consent Capture
  Scenario: User provides consent independently
    Given a consent capture interface is available
    When a user provides consent
    Then the consent is captured and recorded
    And the consent record is stored independently
rationale: Verifies that consent can be captured as a standalone operation without requiring other systems or processes to be active or completed first.
generationSummary: Test cases for independent consent capture functionality. These tests verify that consent can be captured independently, without dependencies on other processes or systems, and that the captured consent is properly recorded and managed.
